info.title: Traigent Content-less Best-config Head Routes
info.description: Ref-addressed agent-head read of the content-less optimization channel (plan v2.1 phase 0b). The protected-publish precondition (headers X-Traigent-Agent-Ref and X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation) is declared on POST /api/v1/best-configs in execution/best_config_endpoints.json; its rule and closed refusals are specified there.

get.summary: Read an agent's promotion head by its opaque ref
get.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/best_config_routes.py get_agent_head_by_ref. Resolves `agent_ref` (optimization_identity.resolve_ref, kind agent) inside the caller's tenant and project, keeps agent READ authorization, and returns the head generation (0 / exists=false when never promoted). An SDK captures this generation when an optimization starts and sends it back as X-Traigent-Expected-Head-Generation when it publishes the winner. A foreign, unknown or malformed ref is refused with reference_not_found and nothing is echoed.

200.description: The head generation for the agent and environment.

400.description: head_capture_invalid — the `environment` query value is not in the closed environment enum. Closed refusal envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: Forbidden — caller lacks experiment.read or agent READ authorization.

404.description: reference_not_found — the ref is unknown, foreign, malformed or no longer visible. Closed refusal envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.
